define.content:
Retrieves the current tenure configuration for an item.

The item must belong to the authorized shop. 

Response fields:

response.tenure_setting

  • toggle_status: Indicates whether SSPL tenure is enabled for the item.
  • tenure_key: The active tenure key. It is 0 when SSPL tenure is not enabled.

response.metadata

  • allow_item_management: Indicates whether the seller is allowed to manage item-level tenure settings.
  • sspl_possible_tenures: The tenure keys available for the shop.
  • can_change_tenures：Whether seller can change exact tenure plan.
     

- If allow_item_management is false, item-level tenure management is unavailable.

- If allow_item_management is true, you can use the tenure function for the item.

- If can_change_tenures is false, the tenure keys are fixed by the shop. You can only enable or disable tenure for the item.

- If can_change_tenures is true, the tenure keys are not fixed by the shop. You can choose which tenure level to enable for the item.

- For example, if the available tenure keys are [1, 3, 6], setting tenure_key to 1 enables 1-month tenure. Setting it to 3 enables both 1-month and 3-month tenures. Setting it to 6 enables 1-month, 3-month, and 6-month tenures.

  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,

}',

));
